policy: Holdout cases must be public, SHA-256 pinned before first scoring, and must not be used for detector threshold tuning or confidence calibration. Ambiguous labels are review_only and excluded from hard pass/fail scoring.

cases.label_rationale: Public PX4 issue #26020 documents a real Standard VTOL flight that crashed after switching from Offboard back to Mission mode; the issue provides this Flight Review ULog as the crash flight evidence.
